body: JSON Patch write paths \(`add`\/`replace`\/`copy`\) and `immutableSetByPath` traverse and assign through `__proto__`\, polluting the global `Object.prototype` from untrusted patch\/state paths\.

Commit de6a9bd \"fix\(core\)\: reject prototype\-polluting paths\" fully addresses this suggestion\. It adds a `blockedJsonPointerTokens` set \(`__proto__`\, `constructor`\, `prototype`\) with `hasBlockedJsonPointerToken`\/`isSafeJsonPointerPath` helpers \(applied after JSON Pointer unescaping\)\, and gates every relevant path\: `canWriteBySegments` \(add\/replace\/copy\)\, `readByPath` \(reads\)\, `removeByPathInternal`\, the top\-level `applySpecStreamPatch` guard on `patch.path`\/`patch.from`\, and the state\-store `immutableSetByPath` plus `set`\/`update` in both store factories\. This closes the pollution vector via a shared\-helper approach equivalent to the proposed fix\.
